description: This file defines a class LDAPServerConfig within the namespace OrangeHRM\Tests\LDAP used for testing LDAP server configurations. It includes properties for host, port, encryption, admin distinguished names, and passwords, as well as a static factory method fromArray to instantiate an object from an associative array.
